title: Public API
description: Keys used by the branded site, the booking widget and integrations; signed webhooks for reservation events.
forbidden: You are not allowed to view the public API settings.
overview.channels_hint: Keys only sell on channels switched on in the organization settings.
overview.docs_hint: Endpoints, examples and error codes are in the API docs (Public Booking).
validation.name: Name is required.
validation.rate_limit: Enter a number between 10 and 6000 per minute.
validation.origins: A publishable key needs at least one allowed origin.
validation.url: Enter a valid address starting with https://.
keys.form_description: A secret key is used server to server and never given to a browser. A publishable key is for the site / widget and only opens short-lived sessions from allowed origins.
keys.fields.channel_hint: Prices, capacity rules and the approval flow follow this channel.
keys.fields.name: Name
keys.fields.allowed_origins_hint: One per line (https://domain.com). http://localhost:3000 for local development.
keys.fields.rate_limit_hint: Per key for secret keys, per browser session for publishable keys.
keys.fields.grace: How long should the old key keep working?
keys.rotate_description: A new key with the same settings is issued. The old key keeps working for the chosen period while you switch your integrations.
keys.revoke_description: The key and its open sessions stop at once. This cannot be undone.
keys.empty_description: Create a key for the branded site, the widget or your own integration.
keys.columns.name: Name
secret.once_description: For your security the full value is not shown again. Rotate the key if you lose it.
secret.secret_description: Use it server side in the Authorization: Bearer header; never put it in a browser or mobile app.
secret.publishable_description: Can be added to the site or widget page; it only opens 30-minute booking sessions from allowed origins.
secret.webhook_description: Verify the Rentopia-Webhook-Signature header of incoming requests with this secret (HMAC-SHA256 of "timestamp.body").
webhooks.form_description: Events of reservations made through the public API are sent signed to this address; failed sends are retried with growing intervals.
webhooks.fields.name: Name
webhooks.fields.url_hint: A public https address; internal network addresses are refused.
webhooks.rotate_description: The new secret signs every delivery from now on; update the receiver right away.
webhooks.delete_description: The address and all its delivery records are deleted.
webhooks.empty_description: Add an address to receive reservation events in your own system.
webhooks.columns.name: Name
deliveries.empty_description: Events sent to webhooks are listed here.
toast.test_failed: Test event could not be delivered: {{error}}
